contract.main_mechanism: In Concurrent LoL global placement, treat the default unit cross-die multiplier as an automatic mode: scale each cross-die net weight by a fanout-aware factor (1.30 for two-pin nets, 1.15 for three-pin nets, 1.05 for four-or-more-pin nets).
